notes.attack: A clap opens in a few milliseconds, not in one. Under 3 ms the ear stops hearing an attack and starts hearing an edge.
notes.crack: SPARK-2: each hand's slap, band-passed at `crackHz` and falling an e-fold in `crackDecay`, at `crack` of the hand. The references' claps stand a decibel over their body in the first 6 ms, ours stood three under. Nought here builds nothing; a place voices the block.
